frozen_methods.discoverer_view: TRAIN_AND_VALIDATION_ONLY, each with normalized x and measured y; no TEST rows.
frozen_methods.fit: OLS on TRAIN via deterministic rank-checked normal equations in stdlib; no arbitrary execution/eval.
frozen_methods.select: Lowest validation RMSE plus model complexity penalty 0.025*nonconstant_term_count*train-only response standard deviation; tie break lexicographically by frozen basis order.
frozen_methods.candidate_gate: PROPOSE if validation RMSE / constant-mean validation RMSE < 0.20; otherwise ABSTAIN.
frozen_methods.metric_primary: Fresh held-out RMSE as raw units and normalized by training y standard deviation.
frozen_methods.metric_secondary: Held-out RMSE ratio vs validation-selected benchmark among mean/linear/quadratic; count 5%-plus improvements, ties and losses without hiding negative results.
frozen_methods.null_control: For both datasets permute validation y values with fixed cyclic shift by 3 while keeping train unchanged; deliberate pairing corruption must not be interpreted as new scientific law.
frozen_methods.verification: Checker on separate GitHub runner recomputes predictions from source measurements, baseline fits independently, rejects coefficient tampering and model injection.
frozen_methods.fail_closed: If dataset content, sample counts, split, source provenance, model dimensions, metric finiteness or SHA mismatches, fail.
